featured_reviews.name: Kushal Patodia
featured_reviews.review_text:
We purchased a Krome digital lock from Glitorium, but encountered an issue with it. Despite informing the owner and their staff multiple times, no action has been taken. I personally visited their store four times, yet received no assistance. They have also been unresponsive to calls and WhatsApp messages. I have screenshots of my chats showing a complete lack of response from the owner, even after reading all the messages. The after-sales service at Glitorium is extremely disappointing. Buying all our products from them was a major mistake, and they do not appear to be a trustworthy seller.

Reply to owner’s response:

Thank you for your response. It appears that Glitorium becomes responsive only when a customer posts a review on Google. Commendable efficiency, indeed.

To clarify, the technician did not visit three times as stated, but only twice. During the first visit, the original chip was replaced with another chip, which in itself was defective. During the second visit, the technician reinstalled the original chip.

At no point was the option of purchasing a new unit communicated to us. Moreover, since the product is still under warranty, it is unclear why we would be expected to incur additional costs, especially for a product that already costs ₹17,000. What was consistently conveyed to us was that Glitorium was attempting to arrange a replacement chip, and this has been the communication for the past month.

As for the proposed “solution,” had you reviewed the audio note shared earlier (as referenced in the screenshots), you would not have asked “how you would like to proceed”. It has already been several months, and this is an essential, everyday-use product.

At this stage, your assistance is neither required nor expected. We will make our own arrangements moving forward.

Thank you, Glitorium….for nothing.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Kushal,

Our technician has visited your residence three times to inspect the lock and assess the issue. During the inspection, it was found that the internal chip has been damaged due to usage. Unfortunately, this particular component is not available as a replacement part and such parts any of the brands such as Yale, Godrej, or Ozone do not provide.

As a result, the only available solution would be to buy a new unit. This has been communicated during the previous visits as well. We would appreciate it if you could please confirm how you would like to proceed so that we can assist you further.

Thank you for your understanding.
